notes.subject: faamuyɔrɔw
notes.rationale: ישועות plural 'deliverances/victories'; some versions read 'tower of salvation' (KJV/JPS) with different text

notes.subject: מגדיל
notes.rationale: 'he magnifies (the deliverances of his king)' vs KJV/JPS 'tower of salvation' — verb vs noun reading of מגדול

notes.subject: Dawida
notes.rationale: gloss of Mashíaciden supplied since Bambara has no common word for 'anointed one'

notes.subject: עולם
notes.rationale: literally 'concealed / vanishing point' — time beyond sight; rendered as eternity phrase

translation: A bɛ a ka masakɛ faamuyɔrɔw ka bonya, a bɛ hesed kɛ a Mashíaciden (Dawida) ye, Dawid (Dawuda) ni a kisɛw la, fo janka kɔrɔ fitini bɛɛ.
